verdicts.reason: A breaks the composition. The attribution is pulled out into a separate column inside the circle on the right and set larger than it was, so it competes with the quote. The logo floats in the middle under the quote, the can is shrunk into the lower-left circle, the bottom-right is empty dead space and the circles look scattered at random. B keeps the original's structure and proportions: quote, attribution, logo bottom-left and can in the bottom-right circle. Its flaws are minor: the quote mark and quote start a bit low, leaving an empty top band, and the quote's left edge is not quite aligned with the attribution.
